item.title: Like Before but Blue

turns.text: Make a 4:5 poster with a burnt-orange background, cream lettering and a simple cream crescent moon. Text: 'NIGHT MARKET' and 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'. Bold, clean, no other words.
Like before but blue. Just swap the orange background for deep navy; leave everything else where it was.

item.tests: Uses the prior poster as the edit reference and changes only its background colour, preserving text, layout and artwork.

answer_sheet.Which previous output?: The NIGHT MARKET poster just made.
answer_sheet.What should become blue?: Only the burnt-orange background, which should become deep navy.
answer_sheet.What stays unchanged?: The cream lettering and crescent moon, their positions, typography, sizes and the overall layout.
answer_sheet.Exact wording: NIGHT MARKET and SATURDAY 6–10 PM, with no additional words.

must_haves: The final output is one 4:5 poster with a deep navy background instead of burnt orange.
The smaller line reads exactly 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'.
The cream lettering and cream crescent moon retain their previous positions, sizes and appearance.
No new words, decorative elements or layout changes are introduced.
